title: Concurrent agents — two processes race on shared state
expected: exactly one agent succeeds; the other receives an explainable condition failure; audits agree with server truth
actual: 1 winner (agent-a), 1 loser with explicit condition failure; server truth = 1 mutation; per-agent audits consistent
observations: sandbox HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:35503 (correct If-Match semantics)
both agents hold an authorization against the same version
loser saw: "provider refused: at "v2", authorized "v1"" — an explicit, retry-informative condition failure
audit of agent-a: action.executed=1, execution.condition_failed=0 (exactly one of the two)
audit of agent-b: action.executed=0, execution.condition_failed=1 (exactly one of the two)
8-way race: 1 satisfied, 7 condition_failed; provider log has 1 mutation(s)

block_classifications.detail: the losing agent’s stale conditional mutation was refused by the provider (If-Match 412)

notes: Barrier held both agents at the CAS to make the race deterministic; server-side mutation count is the source of truth.
